comment: Scene lengths in beats (120 BPM: 1 beat = 15 frames = 0.5 s), 60 beats = 30 s. Ép. 1 of « La chèvre a encore frappé ». Every cut is hard: the courtyard and the office are continuous sets, and the goat chews on the video's clock. Each proof holds still long enough to read (the scrap in her mouth, PREUVE : 0, the lock screen, the receipt, the score). The rewind plays the counter backwards inside its own scene. The music loops; the picture cuts from her stare back to the receipt in his hand. scripts/chevre-01/make-music.mjs reads this file, so the music follows any retiming of whole scenes; the cues inside a scene are in the scenes and in that script.
